counter_semantics.PERF.pub: Frame publish calls counted before async queue acceptance, including invalid/partial frames and subsequent drops; not ADC conversion count.
counter_semantics.PERF.emitQueued: NOT_REPORTED unless the firmware actually supplies this field; no substitute is inferred.
counter_semantics.PERF.fresh: Firmware freshness classification; partial CRC freshness is not a route-fault verdict.
counter_semantics.PERF.usbSent: When usbStage=queued: packets submitted to the serial sink, not PC receipt or driver completion.
counter_semantics.PERF.usbBytes: Bytes submitted at the USB sink stage identified by usbStage.
counter_semantics.PERF.usbDrop: USB sink packet rejection counter; not necessarily equivalent to scientific frame gaps.
counter_semantics.PERF.queueDrop: Transport descriptor queue drops; preserve separately from USB counters.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.sinkQueued: Accepted serial sink slots (data, diagnostics and replies), not frames.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.sinkDropped: Sink failures, including line-drop events; do not add lineDropped again.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.driverAcceptedBytes: Bytes accepted by the ESP-IDF driver, not acknowledgement from the PC.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.driverDrained: Observed successful wait_tx_done checks; neither bytes nor frames nor PC receipt.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.rxBytes: Firmware command RX bytes; distinct from collector raw received bytes.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.lineDropped: Line assembler drops; a scientific frame can have a different loss count.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.partialWrite: A serial sink packet deadline expired after some bytes were accepted.
counter_semantics.USBSTREAM.timeout: A serial sink packet was not completely accepted before its deadline.
counter_semantics.enumerated: Preserve unknown; SOF presence does not prove host application receipt.

limitations: ASCII CRC success does not establish ADC SPI integrity, freshness, or analog accuracy.
RECORDED means requested time/configuration were observed; inspect invalid samples, faults and drops separately.
Query counter intervals bracket their own timestamps, not exact capture boundaries.
No rates or counter deltas are inferred across boots; group timestamps use microseconds.
Counter decreases are left unresolved; sequence wraps use u32 half-range arithmetic.
Raw ADC samples, CPU utilization, and maximum contiguous heap block cannot be reconstructed from absent fields.
